besluite.fout: Two clauses with their own subject and verb ('die pot ... gedroog', 'is dit ... gebak') are joined by 'en' without the AWS comma, and the carried-over inversion 'en is dit' reads stiffly.
besluite.rede: Adds the required AWS comma and makes the next step explicit with 'toe', with the same actions in the same order.
'word weer pap in water' is natural Afrikaans with the place phrase moved to the end, so the proposal only changes the word order.

besluite.fout: 'Hulle' follows a clause where 'hulle' means the heads, so the reader briefly attaches it to the wrong noun.
besluite.rede: Naming the archaeologists removes the pronoun stumble without changing who thinks what, and leaves the protected word 'argeoloë' intact.
